surveys.report_section: Dangers to Navigation and HCell final review, pages 12, 14, 17 and Appendix I
surveys.interpretation: Two reported dangers: a 4-fathom-4-foot rock and a 4-fathom-5-foot shoal at the edge of multibeam coverage. The report recommends removal of an older charted wreck as disproved; that item is not treated as a measured reef or fishing target.

hazards.radius_meaning: Historical rock review hold, not a navigational safety radius.
Shoalest observed point lies at the multibeam edge; this is a review hold, not a safety distance.

surveys.report_section: HCell approval endnote 18 and HCell Report section 5, pages 13 and 16
surveys.interpretation: The field section says no DTON; final Pacific Hydrographic Branch HCell review identifies one 53-foot DTON. Use the final review. The report does not establish present chart status or a safe standoff distance.

hazards.radius_meaning: Conservative candidate-review hold around a historical sounding; not a navigational safety radius.

surveys.report_section: Final HCell approval endnotes 11, 14 and section 5; original DTON report, pages 13, 16 and 19–21
surveys.interpretation: The field narrative says no DTON; the final HCell review records one 16.457 m DTON. A charted wreck PA is just outside the surveyed area and is conservatively held where the BAG bbox overlaps it.

hazards.radius_meaning: Historical feature review hold, not a navigational safety radius.
Uncertain charted position just outside survey coverage; verify current ENC before any navigation or fishing plan.

surveys.report_section: Dangers to Navigation and final-tide correction, pages 11–12; north-border feature is documented by H11732
surveys.interpretation: One reported rock was corrected from feet to fathoms after final tides. A second feature on the northern survey border is screened from the neighboring H11732 report.

hazards.radius_meaning: Historical rock review hold, not a navigational safety radius.
Neighboring survey reports a fully covered rock; this is a review hold, not navigation clearance.

surveys.report_section: Dangers to Navigation and data-quality section, pages 7 and 11–12
surveys.interpretation: Three rocks were corrected from feet to fathoms in the final report. One has a survey hole over its top and an unknown least depth; retain a larger review hold. Check current ENC before any passage.

hazards.radius_meaning: The reported sounding is 2 fathoms 5 feet or shoaler; the least depth is unknown because full coverage was not achieved. Historical review hold, not a navigational safety radius.
Least depth was not determined; candidate-review hold only.
Historical rock review hold, not a navigational safety radius.
